description: Compact Seyal navigation index. Authoritative architecture, specs, milestones, code and tests always win on conflict.

nodes.title: TerminalExecution
nodes.summary: Owns one terminal endpoint/PTY, child lifecycle, authoritative terminal state, and attachment/projection state.

nodes.title: TerminalState
nodes.summary: Canonical VT/grid state mutated by the incremental parser; renderer and GUI consume derived projection and never own a second authoritative grid.

nodes.title: BlockTimeline
nodes.summary: Workspace metadata keyed by ExecutionId and logical history anchors. Blocks own no PTY, VT, grid, child, renderer, or copied terminal output.

nodes.title: ADR-004 VT state ownership
nodes.summary: Establishes one authoritative TerminalState, incremental parser framing, parser/state separation, screen ownership, line identity, and generation-based damage.

nodes.title: ADR-003 OSS/commercial boundary
nodes.summary: Seyal OSS is canonical and independent; seyal-commercial consumes a pinned OSS revision and proprietary code never becomes an OSS dependency.

nodes.title: seyal-terminal
nodes.summary: Portable terminal-semantics ownership boundary for VT parsing, canonical terminal state, history identity and damage semantics.
